environment.description: EKS cluster running the order-consumer as a Deployment in namespace 'processing'. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with privileged securityContext. Container mounts hostPath /var/log/host for debug logging and /var/run/docker.sock for sidecar operations. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforced. The internal GraphQL service (Hasura) accepts arbitrary queries without depth limiting or query complexity analysis. SQS messages originate from an SNS topic that external partners can publish to via a shared access policy.
